statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54512 (GHSA-j3rv-43j4-c7qm): jackson-databind did not run the PolymorphicTypeValidator on the generic type parameters of a polymorphic type id, so a class the validator denies could be instantiated by naming it as a type parameter of an allowed container type. The advisory lists jackson-databind 2.10.0 to 2.18.7 and 2.19.0 to 2.21.3 as affected, fixed in 2.18.8 and 2.21.4, and lists no 2.22 range: https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/security/advisories/GHSA-j3rv-43j4-c7qm. The fix is pull request https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/pull/5988, merged as commit https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/commit/434d6c511de7fdd9872f29157aafb6162d12d8d5, which the jackson-databind-2.18.8 and jackson-databind-2.22.0 release tags both contain. Read every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64 (16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0; each version has the same index checksum on both architectures, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only), recursing into every jar and nested jar. jackson-databind ships only as /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/jackson-databind-<version>.jar (version from the jar's Maven metadata), and each shipped jar is byte-identical to the Maven Central jar of that version. No other jar or nested jar holds jackson/databind classes under any package prefix, and no jar holds Jackson 3 (tools.jackson) classes. jackson-databind is 2.18.6 in 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.5-r3, 2.18.8 in 8.14.5-r4 and 8.14.5-r5, 2.18.9 in 8.14.5-r6 to 8.14.5-r9, 2.18.11 in 8.14.6-r0 to 8.14.7-r0 and 2.18.12 in 8.14.8-r0. DatabindContext carries the type-parameter check the fix adds in every shipped jackson-databind jar from 2.18.8 on (as _validateTypeParameter in 2.18.8 to 2.18.11 and 2.22.0 to 2.22.3, and as the reworked _validateContainedTypes in 2.18.12 and 2.22.4); the 2.18.6 class has neither. Every build from 8.14.5-r4 on carries jackson-databind 2.18.8 or later, so the range ends at 8.14.5-r4.
